turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, and Monaco. Please note that we also deliver to Portugal. 🙂

Regarding customs duties and taxes, they are included in the price displayed on our website.

For deliveries to Switzerland, the all-inclusive price covers the Swiss VAT (8.1%), logistics fees, and customs duties. If the carrier (DHL) requests payment for these fees from you, simply send us the corresponding PDF invoice. We will then settle the payment directly with them. 🎉

turns.q: Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?
turns.replyTail:
We do not offer price matching, and we do not refund the difference if the price of a product decreases after your order has been confirmed.

To take advantage of a new price or a price reduction, you must cancel your current order or return your original order in order to place a new one under current conditions. 🙂

turns.replyText:
We offer comprehensive warranties on our products to ensure your peace of mind. The duration of the warranty depends on the item:

Mattresses (Hybride, Pelote): 10-year full warranty.
Mattress (Grand Ours): Repairable for life.
Bed Bases, Headboards, and Wooden Beds: 5-year warranty.
Duvets, Pillows, and Bolsters: 5-year warranty (2 years for kids' versions).
Bedding Protection: 2-year warranty.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects, such as visible foam indentation (greater than 2.5 cm for mattresses), significant physical deformation, or defects in the cover like failed seams or zippers.

Please note that the warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, accidental damage (stains, burns, etc.), or issues resulting from improper use or lack of a suitable bed base. For mattresses specifically, they must be unboxed within 30 days of delivery to remain covered.

If you notice a defect, simply send an email to hello@tediber.com with a description of the issue, some photos or videos, and your proof of purchase. Our team will review your request and arrange for a repair or replacement if the defect is covered. 🙂
